description: Rack middleware that verifies a short-lived EdDSA JWT minted by a Cloudflare Worker in front of your app. Requests without a valid token get a 404 and never reach the application. Claims can carry data the origin needs, such as feature flags. No Rails or ActiveSupport dependency at runtime.
